label: Bible Study
prompt: Wherefore God also hath highly _____ him, and given him a name which is above every name:
verse: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
note: After the humility of the cross comes the exaltation — and a name above every name.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and _____, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
verse: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.
note: Around the throne the worship never stops, day or night: Holy, holy, holy, Lord God Almighty.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Behold the _____ of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
verse: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
note: The KJV's 'fowls of the air' are just birds — no barns, no savings plan, and fed every day anyway.

label: Deep Water
prompt: The days of our years are _____ years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
verse: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
note: A score is twenty, so threescore and ten is seventy — from the only psalm credited to Moses.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of _____ shall come from the presence of the Lord;
verse: Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
note: Peter at Solomon's porch, right after the lame man walked: repent, and 'times of refreshing' will come.
